content.text: Confirmed: the Contractor obtains Company data/records and may access Company computer systems, so cyber coverage is material. The clause meets fallback on E&O ($1M) but has no cyber cover at all — failing the fallback. Let me validate a minimal insertion.

input.summary: Add cyber/privacy liability coverage to the existing insurance clause, since Contractor handles Company data and systems.
input.comment: [Playbook] Contractor obtains Company data and records and may access our computer systems, so we need cyber/privacy liability cover alongside the existing general liability and E&O coverage; our playbook position is USD 5,000,000 for vendors processing Customer Data. We can accept USD 2,000,000 as a fallback if the higher limit is not commercially available to Contractor.

ops.oldText: with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services
ops.newText: with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), and, where Contractor processes, stores or has access to Company data or Confidential Information, cyber and privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least five million dollars ($5,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services
